stories.excerpt: Alexey Batrakov scored twice in the opening 15 minutes as Galatasaray beat Stuttgart 2-0 at RAMS Park on Tuesday, a result that gave the Turkish side its second consecutive win in the Champions League league phase. Batrakov struck from close range in the 12th minute and added a second three minutes later. Stuttgart then spent much of the night pressing for a way back and was repeatedly denied by goalkeeper Ugurcan Cakir and the woodwork. The visitors had the game’s first big chance in the eighth minute. Maximilian Mittelstadt ran down the left and crossed to the back post, where Jamie Leweling side-footed a shot against the left-hand post. The ball rolled along the goal line and bounced off the other post, then stayed out. Galatasaray took the lead four minutes later. Roland Sallai ran into the right side of the box and pulled the ball back, Jeff Chabot intercepted, and it fell to Batrakov, who rifled a strike into the roof of the net.
